Street-to-Track Performance: Testing Michelin’s Ultimate Sports Car Tires

Performance car owners face a constant dilemma: swapping tires for a weekend track day is impractical, yet standard street tires rarely handle extreme track limits. In this track test, host Scotty Reiss puts two distinct performance tire philosophies to the test using the Toyota GR Supra and Chevrolet Corvette C8.

The experiment begins in the Toyota Supra equipped with the Michelin Pilot Sport 4 S, a tire engineered to serve as a daily driver during the workweek and a capable track option on weekends. Beyond providing predictable dynamics on twisty mountain roads, the Pilot Sport 4 S delivered surprisingly strong traction on a wet track, which is a surface where aggressive performance tires typically struggle.
